title: Show HN: Ante, a coding agent in a single binary that runs offline
summary: Ante is a coding agent packaged as a single binary that runs entirely offline, allowing developers to use AI-powered code assistance without internet connectivity or cloud API dependencies.
problem_solved: Enables offline, privacy-preserving AI coding assistance without requiring cloud services or internet connectivity
why_valuable: Provides enterprise-friendly, self-hosted coding agent that eliminates data privacy concerns and works in air-gapped environments
